en: Hello, invoice {inv_no} from {vendor} for {amount} on {project} is approved for payment. The due date is {due}. Please schedule the payment.
mt: Bonjour, la facture {inv_no} de {vendor} pour {amount} le {project} est approuvée pour le paiement.

en: Hello, we drew {amount} from the reserve of {project} on {date} for: {reason}. The reserve left is {left}. Approved by {approved_by}.
mt: Bonjour, nous avons tiré {amount} de la réserve de {project} sur {date} pour: {reason}.

en: Hello {sponsor}, please approve transfer {tr_id} on {project}: {amount} from {from_cat} to {to_cat}. Reason: {reason}.
mt: Bonjour {sponsor}, veuillez approuver le transfert {tr_id} le {project}: {amount} de {from_cat} à {to_cat}.

en: Hello {contact}, we sent invoice {invoice_no} for {amount} for the milestone {milestone} on {project}. It is due on {due}. Please tell us if anything is missing.
mt: Bonjour {contact}, nous avons envoyé la facture {invoice_no} pour {amount} pour le jalon {milestone} le {project}.

en: Hello {contact}, we received your payment of {amount} for invoice {invoice_no} on {paid_on}. Thank you.
mt: Bonjour, nous avons reçu votre paiement de la facture le 3 février.

en: Hello, the forecast of {project} is {over_by} above its budget and the cost index is {cpi}. The manager is {manager}. Please look at the recovery plan this week.
mt: Bonjour, la prévision de {project} est {over_by} au-dessus de son budget et l'indice de coût est {cpi}.

en: To date {col:projects.spent} is spent, which is {col:projects.used} of the budget now, and {col:projects.left} is left. The forecast cost at completion is {col:projects.eac}. The cost check shows: {col:projects.state}.
mt: À ce jour {col:projects.spent} est dépensé, ce qui est {col:projects.used} du budget maintenant, et {col:projects.left} est laissé. Le coût prévu à l'achèvement est {col:projects.eac}.

en: The budget now is {col:forecast.bac}. The actual cost to date is {col:forecast.ac}, which is {col:forecast.used_pct} of the budget.
mt: Le coût réel à ce jour est de {col:forecast.ac}, qui est {col:forecast.used_pct} du budget.

en: The reserve planned is {col:forecast.reserve}. Of this {col:forecast.drawn} was drawn and {col:forecast.reserve_left} is left.
mt: La réserve prévue est {col:forecast.reserve}.

en: Project: {col:forecast.project}. Project manager: {col:forecast.manager}. Sponsor: {col:forecast.sponsor}.
mt: Le chef de projet, le commanditaire.

en: Budget now {col:forecast.bac}. Percent complete {col:forecast.pct}. Percent planned by now {col:forecast.planned_pct}.
mt: Le budget est maintenant en pourcentage, le pourcentage prévu est maintenant en pourcentage.

en: The cost performance index is {col:forecast.cpi}: a value below 1 means each unit of money spent has earned less than a unit of planned work. The schedule performance index is {col:forecast.spi}: a value below 1 means the work is behind the plan.
mt: L'indice de performance des coûts est {col:forecast.cpi}: une valeur inférieure à 1 signifie que chaque unité d'argent dépensée a gagné moins d'une unité de travail prévu.

en: The forecast at completion is {col:forecast.eac}, a variance of {col:forecast.vac} against the budget. The cost forecast shows: {col:forecast.state}.
mt: La prévision à l'achèvement est de {col:forecast.eac}, une variance de {col:forecast.vac} par rapport au budget.

en: The price now is {col:forecast.price} and the margin at completion is {col:forecast.margin}. The cost forecast shows: {col:forecast.state}.
mt: Le prix actuel est {col:forecast.price} et la marge à l'achèvement est {col:forecast.margin}.

en: Order amount: {col:orders.amount}. Tax: {col:orders.tax}. Total with tax: {col:orders.total}. Expected on: {col:orders.expected}.
mt: Montant de la commande: {col:orders.amount}. Taxe: {col:orders.tax}. Total avec taxe: {col:orders.total}.

en: Each quote is scored out of 100 with these weights: price {set:w_price}, lead time {set:w_lead} and quality {set:w_quality}. The chosen vendor is {col:requests.chosen_vendor}, on order {col:requests.order}.
mt: Chaque offre est notée sur 100 avec ces poids: prix {set:w_price}, délai {set:w_lead} et qualité {set:w_quality}.

en: Vendor: {col:vendors.name} ({col:vendors.service}). Contact: {col:vendors.contact}, telephone {col:vendors.phone}.
mt: Le fournisseur: {col:vendors.name} {col:vendors.service}.

en: To: {col:changes.contact}, telephone {col:changes.client_phone}. Project: {col:changes.project}.
mt: À: {col:changes.contact}, téléphone {col:changes.client_phone}.

en: The change adds {col:changes.extra_days} working days and is priced at {col:changes.price}. The status is {col:changes.status}, decided on {col:changes.decided_on}.
mt: Le changement ajoute {col:changes.extra_days} jours ouvrables et est évalué à {col:changes.price}.

en: An amount of {col:contingency.amount} is drawn from the project reserve and moved to the category {col:contingency.category}. Reason: {col:contingency.reason}.
mt: Un montant de {col:contingency.amount} est prélevé sur la réserve de projet et transféré dans la catégorie {col:contingency.category}.

en: The reserve planned is {col:contingency.reserve}. After this draw {col:contingency.drawn} is drawn to date, {col:contingency.left} is left and {col:contingency.share} of the reserve is used. The reserve check shows: {col:contingency.check}.
mt: La réserve prévue est {col:contingency.reserve}. Après ce tirage {col:contingency.drawn} est tiré à la date, {col:contingency.left} est laissé et {col:contingency.share} de la réserve est utilisé.

en: To: {col:projects.contact}, {col:projects.client}, telephone {col:projects.client_phone}. Project: {col:projects.name}.
mt: À: {col:projects.contact}, {col:projects.client}, téléphone {col:projects.client_phone}.

en: Hello {owner}, the indicator "{indicator}" is {current} {unit} against a threshold of {threshold}. Please act on risk {risk}.
mt: Bonjour {owner}, l'indicateur "{indicator}" est {current} {unit} contre un seuil de {threshold}.

en: Hello {owner}, issue {issue_id} "{title}" is {over} days overdue. Please send me a new date today.
mt: Bonjour, le numéro 2 est en retard de 3 jours. S'il vous plaît envoyez-moi une nouvelle date aujourd'hui.

en: Hello, {project} has {open_risks} open risks, {high_risks} high or critical, with an expected cost of {exposure}. Reserve left: {left}.
mt: Bonjour, {project} a {open_risks} des risques ouverts, {high_risks} élevés ou critiques, avec un coût attendu de {exposure}.

en: Hello {sponsor}, {project} has {open_risks} open risks, {high_risks} of them high or critical. Expected cost {exposure}, reserve left {left}.
mt: Bonjour, {sponsor}, {project} a {open_risks} des risques ouverts, {high_risks} d'entre eux élevés ou critiques.

en: Hello {sponsor}, issue {issue_id} "{title}" needs your decision by {due}. Please call me today.
mt: Bonjour, le numéro 2 a besoin de votre décision d'ici demain.

en: Hello {sponsor}, change request {change_id} "{title}" costs {cost} and adds {days} days. The route is {route}. Please decide.
mt: Bonjour {sponsor}, demande de changement {change_id} "{title}" coûte {cost} et ajoute {days} jours.

en: Hello {sponsor}, change {change} "{title}" was rejected on {date}. Reason: {conditions}.
mt: Bonjour {sponsor}, le changement {change} "{title}" a été rejeté le {date}.

en: Hello {owner}, the lessons workshop for {project} is on {date}. Please prepare the {phase} phase.
mt: Bonjour {owner}, l'atelier de leçons pour {project} est sur {date}.

en: Hello, issue {issue_id} "{title}" concerns your delivery to {project}. Please respond by {due}.
mt: Bonjour, le problème {issue_id} "{title}" concerne votre livraison à {project}.

en: Hello, "{title}" on {project} is at level {level}. May I ask for your support?
mt: Bonjour, je peux vous demander votre soutien ?

en: Hello {owner}, your action {action_id} "{action}" was due on {due}. Please finish it or send me a new date.
mt: Bonjour, votre action devait être terminée le 3 s'il vous plaît ou envoyez-moi une nouvelle date.

en: The expected cost of the open risks is {col:raid.exposure}. The reserve planned is {col:raid.reserve}, of which {col:raid.drawn} is drawn and {col:raid.left} is left. The reserve check shows: {col:raid.reserve_check}.

mt: Parmi les {col:raid.open_risks} risques ouverts, {col:raid.critical_risks} se trouvent dans la zone critique de la carte de chaleur et {col:raid.high_risks} sont élevés ou critiques.
